teaser: An answer to Nitin Pandya: a kill switch cannot stop a valid workflow acting on a tampered record; a signed mandate checked outside it can.
core_idea: When a valid workflow moves money on a tampered record, the missing control is a signed mandate for every change that can release money, checked by a verifier outside the workflow, which also answers who is accountable.

nodes.label: Tampered record
nodes.summary: A mule account in place of the borrower's.

nodes.label: Kill switch
nodes.summary: Stops a model, not a workflow.

nodes.label: Signed mandate
nodes.summary: Who, under which grant, what scope.

quotes.text: Nothing refused it. Only Dinis noticed.
An agent acts only on a signed record that it has checked.
